name: ShuyoNote
description: Search and read your local ShuyoNote notes; with permission, create pages and append content. Your data stays on your machine.
description_zh: 检索、阅读你本机的 ShuyoNote 笔记；授权后可以新建页面或追加内容。数据留在本机，只把命中的片段交给模型。
description_en: Search and read notes in your local ShuyoNote app; with permission, create pages and append content. Your data stays on your machine.
examples_zh: 帮我找一下笔记里关于焦煤招标的材料
最近一周我改过哪些笔记？
把这周的项目进展记到「周报」那一页
读一下「招标知识库」那一页的全文
别的空间里有没有提到 MCP 的笔记？
examples_en: Find my notes about the coal tender
Which notes did I edit in the last week?
Append this week's progress to my weekly report
Read the full text of my "tender knowledge base" page
Are there notes about MCP in another space?
